scene: On a windswept black-sand Icelandic shore with snowy mountains and a column of steam rising from the ground behind, Grim, huge and expressive in the foreground (cream round face, short dark-brown hair, short neat dark beard, olive-green wool tunic, tan belt, black mitten hands), stands with arms spread wide and a smug, triumphant grin, while right behind him a neat wooden boundary marker already stands in the turf and a stern Icelandic farmer with a red hood leans on it, pointing at him. His wife Halla (blue-grey dress, white headcloth) and a tired cow look on from the beached cargo ship. Visible hardship: he crossed the ocean for empty land and found it already taken.

Inside a dim, smoky turf house in deep winter, Grim, huge and expressive in the foreground (short dark-brown hair, short neat dark beard, olive-green tunic, black mitten hands), clutches one small bundle of hay to his chest with wide, panicked eyes, while a row of thin, hungry cows stares at him from their stalls, a twisted driftwood rafter sags overhead and snow piles against the doorway. Visible hardship: the whole winter depends on a pile of grass.
